decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is used).
Condition : 5 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No. 2 Lyncroft Gardens.

Condition : 6 - The windows formed in the northern elevation of the two-storey side extension shall be obscure glazed and non-opening and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 7 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank (western and eastern) walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - Notwithstanding the details shown in the approved plans, the ground floor level of the proposal shall be finished in red brick and the first floor level in pebble-dashing to match the finish of the main house.  This shall be permanently retained.
Condition : 9 - No part of the roof of the single-storey rear extension shall be used as or altered to form a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.
description: Erection of two storey side and single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse and alterations to existing garage.
